issues.detail: The Greek 'πνευμα εχουσα ασθενειας' (having a spirit of infirmity) is translated as 'bị Thánh Linh yếu đuối' (being by/affected by the Holy Spirit [of] weakness). In Vietnamese, 'Thánh Linh' specifically refers to the Holy Spirit, whereas the Greek 'πνεῦμα' simply means 'spirit'. This adds a specific theological entity (the Holy Spirit) that is not present in the Greek text.
